decisions.reason: Product C is close to the firm's established offer and has maintained its own website presence since 2023, indicating the firm can assimilate and build on existing knowledge.
Product D is distant from the firm's established offer, limiting the firm's ability to recognize, assimilate, and apply the necessary knowledge despite its website presence.
Product E is close to the firm's established offer and benefits from existing production and R&D knowledge, making early results easier to interpret and improve.
